newsitem.title: CHILE: CCU winery unit approves capital rise.
newsitem.headline: CCU winery unit approves capital rise.

text.p: Shareholders of Chilean winery Vina San Pedro SA, a unit of Cervecerias Unidas, approved a capital increase of $15.8 million, or 6.6 billion pesos, company officials said.

The capital increase will go toward funding about half of San Pedro's $31 million investment package, which includes plans to buy about 1,000 hectares of vineyards and expand a bottling plant in the town of Molina.
The rest of the investment plan will be funded with credit, said CCU general manager Francisco Perez Mackenna.
Shareholders approved the capital increase at a meeting in Santiago.
San Pedro exported 1.2 million cases of wine last year, making it Chile's third largest exporter, CCU officials have said. It hopes to raise exports to 1.5 million cases this year.
